No gratuitous sex involved, but kindness and humor found when there is a rest time between operations.  As an ex-GI with 40+ years in the military, I enjoyed the ride.

Chianna and Kris Chemistry from the beginning. Hot insta-love and a bit of drama make this a quick and fun read.

There is an age gap, Kris is 37 and Chianna is 20, but it’s only mentioned twice and not the main focus of the story.

I received a free copy of this book via Booksprout and am voluntarily leaving a review.

Awesome book Read this book to my 4 year old grandson and he loved it!  Kept his attention, which is a hard thing to do at this age.  He's taking golf lessons this summer, so this book will help him understand the game of golf.

The main character, in a highly paid position is such a wimp, I was rolling my eyes through most of the book and thought how did she ever progress in her career.  The parallel story could have been a nice addition but it lacked a smooth segway.  Sorry to say, I would not recommend this book.
Good reading I really like this series of stories and strongly recommend them

Mostly good! I'm a fan of San Sisavath and the whole Purge series, but this was not without flaws. Way way too much repetitious stream of thought stuff, like in Black, for instance. The earlier books didn't do as much of that. And an excellent plot twist, but with no effort to explain how that could be.  Even so, I remain a fan of the overall series, and hope for more!

Great read. I kept putting myself in his place.  What would I have done in the same situation? A few things differently but then, I'm a coward.  Will always wonder if he lived, stayed with Jillian, went to court or got fired.

Another great book from Frankie Bow I read a LOT.  I am, myself, a writer, and a professional editor.  And as I said, I read a LOT, and I come across a LOT of Really Crappy Writing on Amazon. But never with Frankie Bow.  She's a wonderful writer, and her stories are just so much fun, I'm always sorry when the books end. Frankie--hurry up, please, and write a bunch more of these books!  I love them. This one was no exception--I thoroughly enjoyed it from page 1 right through to the end.

Don't miss out... This was a great continuance of the Lost Kings MC series.  If you have not started reading the series yet,  you are really missing out. Autumn Lake Jones has a way of writing that keeps me coming back for more.  The characters in her books become like your family and/or your best friends and you truly want to know what will happen next.  Several surprises in this latest book about Hiede and Murphy that you don't want to miss.

Great reading There should be a movie .

A much sadder tale So much has changed over the course of the intervening years. Yet others still the same. Paul bound in the course of events. Fighting against the tide. So much knowledge and power and still so little of either. Tragedy ensues as Paul always knew it would. And he stays the course.

Good for ESL students This book presents 1400 common idioms used in English they are arranged alphabetically. The have straight-forward definition and example of usage.
I was hoping for a book that explained the origin of some of these expressions. But alas, that is not this book. If you speak English as your first language you don’t need this book.
well worth the time Very thought provoking book.

Jpegs The digital book is in scanned jpegs, not formatted as a book. you can't click a chapter in the table of contents and it takes you there like most digital books. Timely read for recent events This is one of those books I had started and just decided to finish.  It is revealing, sometimes dragging but has an end I never saw coming.

Strong, determined pioneer stock Benjamin Hart finds his dreams stifled and his life changed by spur of the minute choices. Yet he doesn't break or waiver in who he is and holding on to his dreams, just modifying them as circumstance dictate. Once again the author offers a glimpse at pioneering life and how they handled adversity. Another entertaining read from this author. Still too short.
A great story Actually, I am somewhat at a loss as to how I might explain how I feel about this book other than to say what a great mind to write such an awesome story!

Positive Ambivalence Lots of fun, intense story this go-round. Not so much a shocker with this one (the final twist that is) but still. 😢  And McLean? Something of a jerk to Emma. If you read it, you’ll find out how.

I wish I could live in Three Pines and have the wonderful and complex residents as my neighbors and friends The locations and events of the last two books seem somewhat fantastical ... but the stories are based on real events. wonderful and refreshing It read like I was part of this small town. The author took the time to develop her characters. In the coming books this is important as it helps with the story. I love books that don't always have a happy ending or tie up loose ends, this makes for a continuing story line as seen in Ms. Hill's other books in this series. I just bought book 4 and if it's anything like the last 3 then I know I'm going to love it.
GREAT AVIATION READ Great read for those of us who are into aviation.  Made me want to fly around the USA in a simpler way, just flying VFR and stopping at small private airfields

"RazorWire" was a kindleunlimited book in which I belong to. The second book isn't a kindleunlimited book.  Since I'm paying for kindleunlimited I don't feel like buying other books.  This has happened on other occasions also. I have read other complaints from kindleunlimited readers.  I hope this policy changes

Very insightful Referred by R.C. Sproul, Jr. He said this would give insight and explain Roman 1, it definitely does. It's almost like reading something from C.S. Lewis but real life characters. The devil is very patient and subtle. Mr. Johnson is very thorough in his research and description of events. I highly recommend for the serious bible student.

Loved this story, highly recommend. What an awesome story. I have read almost all of Nicole Snow's book and have enjoyed every one. The writing is always great and the characters are engaging. This story is about Summer and Jackson. He saves her from some young punks and they have a summer together. Then tragedy happens and their lives are torn apart. This was perhaps one of the best stories I have read lately.I received this book free in exchange for an honest review.

A Different Perspective on the Founding of Our Country I had never thought about what the wives were doing while the husbands were out "founding our country."  It was amazing to see that many of them were minding the home front (and covering its expenses!), supporting their husbands' efforts through word and letters, even accompanying them when appropriate.  This book gave me a totally new perspective!  Thank you, Founding Mothers, for all that you did, also!!  (Why do I hear Abigail Ada

All too short While it was all too short, this little Christmas short story is a lovely gift to those who were getting a little miffed at Emma Jameson for keeping Juliet's and Ben's lives so star-crossed. A bit of feminine ingenuity on Lady Victoria's part and a bit of absolute magic lead to a moment of happiness for the young couple.
Love Lynne Marshall captured my attention from the beginning. Hurting lives from choices and circumstances left people with pain and unforgiveness. But true love won.

Good Read I don't normally read what I affectionately refer to as "light reading", but this book has converted me. I found it sweet, funny and with a nice twist at the end.  Without giving anything away, I did skip some of the sad portions, but that didn't interfere with the plot line. Try it, I think you'll like it.
Wow! I love these books!I saw the movie Hunger Games before reading the books - something I don't usually do. But in this case the movie just made me hunger for more!!!!

Learning to eat for renal disease With this book you will learn all about kidney disease and the diet that you should be using for better health. There is a very good meal plan so you can see how easy it is to follow. There is also a list of foods you can eat and cannot eat, so you can make easy choices. There are 250 easy, great tasting recipes for you to try like eggplant casserole, pumpkin bites and Korean pear salad.
Reset I was rereading the O's and the one where the lady went to work for the Zai family. She had to hide from a purple. I would nominate this one for a Reset story. Pretty please?

Was there any lament? Can't begin to tell you how captivating this story was.  If I could read all day and night, I would have, but I finished it as quickly as I could.  Suspenseful, and oh so dangerous.  There's no telling how much inhumanity exists in human beings.  I was surprised at the end.  Sure is a great read.  Looking forward to the next book.

My Favorite Series It's always a pleasure to spend time with Chief Inspector Gamache and Three Pines inhabitants!  If you can, start with the first novel and then give yourself the gift of reading the rest.  It's still a good read if you haven't read the previous books in the series.
The magic is in the folds. Waiting for volume 2.

Once bitten twice shy This was a great sequel to the first book. I stayed mad at Derek through the first half of the book, and I was aggravated with Nicole for allowing him to get close to her again. I wanted her to protect herself and boy did she. Loved that about her.
But, really, if you love someone you have to be willing to open your heart even if they’ve hurt you before. And he was young when it all went down plus he was trying to be a good parent. Life is hard. We don’t get redos. T

Interesting Book If I was the editor, I would leave out the pirates. This series of books is an epic Space Opera. The main theme is contact with the aliens. The author left us hanging on some of his characters and eventually thrown them off the bus. It might be wise to concentrate on one or two characters.

A Time to Remember I remember so much of what was written because my generation lived through this terrible disaster, however Clint Hill included so much insight into the story that the public didn't know about.  That had to be a tough job, one that many couldn't do efficiently.  Today's generation looks at that era as history, but those of us who lived through it remember it like it was yesterday.

Loved it....I want more! This was a very enjoyable book. Loved the story between James and Nuala, and the twists and turns were an added bonus. I'm really developing an addiction to stories about the Fae. Each writer seems to have their own spin on the Fae story, and this one was also different, which makes the story even more appealing to me. Loved it! Hope there's another one coming out soon.

I will miss you! I will definitely miss Jory and Sam.  I've seen them through so much, and I will continue to fill in the blanks of their lives with my imagination.  In case I can't come up with anything better, I will say that this was a great ending to their story.

Fun read. I love cats so when you add them into a romance, well I'm all in. This is a fun read with interesting, intriguing characters. I love how the cat cafe comes into being, how the cats help the people in their lives and of course the happy ending!

Dead Weight If anyone has a weight problem, this book will help you solve it.  I do not know if it was the author's intent, but, he highlighted the weaknesses in those people who just cannot eat sensibly.  The torture the writer described to get these women to shed pounds was amusing, to me, but surely could teach those who cannot say "no" to an extra helping something.  Phyllis Molloff

Good but not Great. This is a good installment in the series, but not a great one.  Jay Allen has kind of written himself into a box in this series.  This episode was predictable from the start and goes just where you think it will end up.  He leaves the important YES/NO question for Book 18.
Delightful Delish Love the new character o Diva Delish. I want a more of her and a full story...not so quick next time.
Great I am not a fan of sad books but this book was excellent. Well written and unexpectedly. Worth the read.
Still in love with this series! So glad William is finally getting his story! Totally deserves it! Can't to read the next book. Highly recommend this series!

Even picture book stories need to have some kind of conclusion. This book made no sense. First of all the word "employee" was a pretty big word for a picture book. Worker would be more understandable. Then the animals go from being anthropomorphic to real. The end. They "put on" their "uniforms", but they didn't... they took off their clothes. Very young children will be confused with "taking off" being "putting on"; even with an adult explanation. Their brains don't process those things yet. Th

Best Reading in a long time!!! I just couldn't put it down. I lost a lot of sleep. LOLOL. I don't want to give any of it away. So read the first chapter. You will see.

Almost really good choices of stories Doesn't contain her really high quality novels but most of the stories are good reads.  Andre Norton's books are worth having.  However, I never liked her witch novels.  I wish she were still with us.

Read it!!! You will not be disappointed! This was a very fast paced book. I couldn't put it down, reading the entire story in one sitting.
